scheme_name: Internship Programme Of The Department Of Expenditure
other_conditions: Indian national pursuing post‑graduation research courses in Economics, Finance or Management
Students in the 4th or 5th year of a 5‑year integrated law or other professional course
Post‑graduate students must have obtained a first‑class graduate degree
Research scholars must have at least 50 % marks in post‑graduation
Students in the 5th year of the integrated law course must have at least 80 % marks in 12th class examination
Interns must furnish a declaration of secrecy before reporting
benefits_summary: Interns receive a token remuneration of ₹10,000 per month and a certificate upon satisfactory completion of the internship.
